As is custom, the Buddha concluded the birth-story by revealing the karmic threads connecting the characters of the past to the present dispensation
Through ultimate sacrifice, life is not lost but transformed. By protecting the Dhamma at all costs, Tulakapandita secured the path to omniscient knowledge, leading countless beings across samsara.
